reason: On Linux x86_64 with uv 0.12.13 and Python 3.12.3, an isolated Basic-auth Simple API reproduced the report. With an explicit named index and matching credential-bearing UV_EXTRA_INDEX_URL, `uv sync --upgrade` and `uv lock --upgrade` exited 0 and sent authentication; `uv upgrade` used a fresh cache, sent no authentication, and exited 1 with the reported 401/unsatisfiable-resolution diagnostic. Existing `crates/uv/tests/it/upgrade.rs::upgrade_allows_registry_source` covers an explicit public index but not authentication.
